footer.about_body: Galing Gear is an independent preparedness project helping Filipino families get ready for typhoons, floods, quakes and brownouts — with clear, practical guides and honest gear picks.
home.lede: Typhoons, floods, earthquakes, brownouts — practical guides to get your family ready, plus the gear, bags and gadgets that actually make the difference when it counts. Everything you need, nothing you don't.
subscribe.lede: Typhoons, floods, earthquakes and brownouts — we write up how to get your family ready, and the gear, bags and gadgets that make the difference. No spam, unsubscribe any time.
